g.text: GALINI · L01 · SEC07 / B precinct, Customs and east descents
Named encounter section / exact neighboring layout + predicted opposing and follower positions / no compiled acceptance
L
F
O

Spatial prediction
B is bounded by complete Boat Shed, Customs and Waterfront
Homes. S5 arrives on the Salt-store side; S6 arrives
behind Customs through the L porch. The 6×6 m site is an
authoring footprint, not implemented planting behavior.
Follower / support
The shore follower needs to round the same M10 corner to
trade the final entry. A teammate through I02 can support
the S6 front, but Customs prevents immediate fire support
across the whole site.
Opponent / retreat
O02 hides a crouching body from some ground positions;
S5/S6 elevation can reveal behind it. A lone holder must
move between shore, S5 and Customs fronts. That is a
hypothesis, not proof that all three are independently
contestable.
World positions · eye = floor +1.674 m · all arrows are predictions

elevated reverse; I02 west/north mouths; S5 and S6 bottom/mid/top and reverse.
